defects.title: sds bridge and start use incompatible ticket_hash semantics
defects.detail: sds bridge writes the SDS fingerprint into pipeline.sds.ticket_hash and pipeline.state.ticket_hash; start compares that value with sha256(description_md), so a normal bridge is reported as ticket changed at start_admission step 4.
defects.workaround: Reset both hashes to sha256(description_md) as a test fixture before start.
defects.impact: Normal SDS -> start flow is blocked; demo avoids it by manually resetting the hashes.

defects.title: dataprocess_param_guard false-positive on read-only source inspection
defects.detail: A read-only Select-String command whose pattern text contained run_sql/create_task/read_task was blocked as a platform call with missing parameters.
defects.workaround: Avoid action tokens in shell command text while inspecting source.
defects.impact: False blocks on harmless read-only inspection commands.

defects.title: backfill_guard blocks static sql check
defects.detail: ddp.py sql check on DDL/ETL/dp_task was blocked because the SQL contained writes and the target table had no read-ledger entry; static compliance checking should not require a platform read.
defects.workaround: Mark the target table as read with a test fixture, then rerun sql check.
defects.impact: The documented 17-item static check cannot run before the read step in a fresh ticket.

defects.title: status --gate treats a finished ticket as an unsupported phase
defects.detail: After finish, current_phase=7; status --gate calls stage_gate(7), which returns gate.unsupported_phase severity=FAIL. The ticket is correctly finished, but the diagnostic looks like a failed gate.
defects.workaround: Use status/governance report for finished tickets; P6 gate was verified before finish.
defects.impact: Misleading closeout signal for operators and automation that inspect status --gate.

defects.title: governance report leaves deployment env/engine blank
defects.detail: governance_report.md shows deploy_log env=- and engine=- although deploy_plan.env=dev and the execution receipt is mock; deploy_log.json does not record env.
defects.workaround: Read deploy_plan.json and deploy_log.json directly for the values.
defects.impact: Minor evidence readability gap; no gate bypass.
